text:
A: Hiya! Oh, it's you, with the files! I'm Kerry.
B: Hiya. Leanne.
A: I said on the photo bit, you looked like you had your head screwed on. Sorry, that's probably a weird thing to hear.
B: No, it's fine. It's just work stuff. I do the books for my dad's plumbing firm.
A: Oh, the books, yeah. I own half a salon, in Walderslade, near Chatham. And I've just had a call with a lady who's an accountant, and she basically sorted my whole life out in three minutes. I've got notes and everything.
B: Nusrat? I had her as well.
A: Did you? Oh my God, wasn't she brilliant? Bit scary, but brilliant.
B: Yeah. She was alright, to be fair. She said something about me managing the engineers that I hadn't thought about.
A: Oh, go on, what was it?
B: Erm, just that I already tell them when they're wrong, so that's sort of managing. My dad's retiring in a few years and I'm meant to take on more.
A: Oh, that's true though, isn't it? I never did any training for managing, I just sort of do it. I've got two juniors and one stylist, and half of it is just noticing when someone's gone quiet and asking if they're alright, d'you know what I mean?
B: Mm. The engineers aren't really the "are you alright" type.
A: No, I bet! Blokes in vans. My Darren's an electrician, he'd hate being asked. You just give him a bacon roll and he's happy.
B: That's my dad, to be fair.
A: Ha! So whereabouts are you?
B: Whittlesey, near Peterborough. In the Fens.
A: Oh, I don't think I've been. Is it nice?
B: It's quiet. There's a straw bear festival in January, people dress up as a bear made of straw and walk round the town.
A: Sorry, a bear made of straw?
B: Yeah. It's old. I just watch, I don't do it.
A: Oh, I love that. We just have the Dickens festival in Rochester, everyone in bonnets. So what d'you do in the evenings then, when you're not chasing people?
B: Walk the dog. Telly. Gogglebox, crime stuff.
A: Gogglebox! I love Gogglebox. It's the only programme my whole family agrees on. And Friday's takeaway night in our house, Chinese, always the same order.
B: Same. Chippy on Friday, Chinese sometimes. I get the same thing every time.
A: What d'you get from the Chinese?
B: Sweet and sour chicken balls, egg fried rice. Nothing spicy.
A: Nothing spicy, no. I'm the same, chicken chow mein, and if Darren orders something hot I won't even try it. And holidays, I'm a creature of habit, Tenerife every year.
B: We go to Tenerife. Same hotel.
A: Oh, everyone in this study goes to Tenerife! I think we should all just meet out there.
B: I'd have to get to the airport four hours early, though.
A: Oh, so would I! I'm a nervous wreck with flights. Darren has to hold my hand at take-off, it's embarrassing. Sorry, I'm rambling now.
B: No, it's fine. I'm not very good at these.
A: You're doing fine, love. Honestly, I'm just a talker, my clients never get a word in. Are you on Xero then, for your dad's? Only Nusrat was asking me what software I use and I went bright red.
B: Yeah, Xero. It's not hard once you get going. I could tell you what I...
